आवेदन करने की अंतिम तिथि नजदीक है ✅

BPSSC Bihar Home Guard Company Commander Recruitment 2026

  • Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 30 July 2026
  • Total : 65 Posts
  • Eligibility : Graduation (Bachelor’s Degree)
  • Advt. No. : 08/2026

Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has invited online applications for Home Guard Company Commander (General) under Home Dept (Special), Govt. of Bihar.

जिन अभ्यर्थियों ने अभी तक फॉर्म नहीं भरा – अंतिम तिथि 30 July 2026 नजदीक है। जल्द Apply करें।

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 30 July 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 30 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Category Candidates : ₹100/-
  • Payment Mode : Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / IMPS / Wallet

Age Limit (as on 01 August 2025)

  • Minimum Age : 20 Years (All Category)
  • Maximum Age UR/General Male : 37 Years
  • Maximum Age UR/General Female : 40 Years
  • Maximum Age BC/EBC Male & Female : 40 Years
  • Maximum Age SC/ST Male & Female : 42 Years

Vacancy Details

Post NameNo. Of PostEligibility
Home Guard Company Commander65Bachelor’s Degree (Graduate) from a recognized University in India

Selection Process

  1. Preliminary Examination
  2. Main Written Examination
  3. Physical Eligibility Test (PET)
  4. Document Verification
  5. Medical Examination

How to Apply

  1. Open official apply portal: https://apply-bpssc.com/bpssc_cor_8_2026/applicationIndex
  2. Register / login for Advt. No. 08/2026
  3. Fill application form carefully
  4. Upload photo, signature and required documents
  5. Pay fee ₹100 and submit before 30 July 2026
  6. Print final application for future use

Apply only through official BPSSC portal. Read the official notification carefully before submitting the form.
